title: GPUMAP: GPU-Accelerated Progressive Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection
abstract: arXiv:2611.06191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dimensionality reduction (DR) techniques are fundamental to the analysis of high-dimensional data, yet their substantial computational cost limits their use in interactive settings. To address this limitation, we present GPU-accelerated Progressive Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (GPUMAP), an efficient progressive DR algorithm designed for interactive use. We identify three atomic operations within UMAP and restructure them into a progressive pipeline. As part of this adaptation, we introduce modifications to UMAP, including operation queues, instance-wise local join, and scheduling strategies. We further accelerate computation by leveraging GPU parallelism, enabling interactive analysis of million-scale datasets on commodity GPU hardware. translated_title: GPUMAP：GPU加速的渐进式均匀流形逼近与投影
translated_abstract: 降维（DR）技术是高维数据分析的基础，但其巨大的计算成本限制了它们在交互式场景中的使用。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了GPU加速的渐进式均匀流形逼近与投影（GPUMAP），这是一种专为交互式使用而设计的高效渐进式降维算法。我们识别出UMAP中的三个原子操作，并将它们重构为渐进式流水线。作为这一改造的一部分，我们对UMAP进行了修改，包括操作队列、实例级局部连接和调度策略。我们进一步利用GPU并行性加速计算，使得在普通GPU硬件上能够对百万级数据集进行交互式分析。最后，我们利用我们的实现系统地研究了渐进式降维的行为，考察了投影随时间相对于真实投影的演化过程。
tldr: GPUMAP通过将UMAP重构为渐进式流水线并利用GPU并行加速，实现了在普通GPU硬件上对百万级数据集的交互式渐进降维分析。
en_tdlr: GPUMAP restructures UMAP into a progressive pipeline and leverages GPU parallelism to enable interactive progressive dimensionality reduction of million-scale datasets on commodity GPU hardware.
